The Sun, the Moon, and Twelve Stars

Imami reports associate the sun and moon with Muhammad and Ali, count twelve Imams, and describe the Mahdi as a ruler of justice. Later writers use these reports to interpret Revelation 12 and other biblical passages.
Section navigation

Revelation 12:1 describes a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet and a crown of twelve stars. Genesis 17:20 promises Ishmael twelve princes. Isaiah 11:1-9, Psalm 72, and Daniel 7:13-14 describe righteous rule and dominion.
The Qur'an swears by a sun and by a moon that follows it (Qur'an 91:1-2), and the Imams' transmitted tafsir names that sun as the Prophet ﷺ and that moon as Ali ﵇.

Shia and Sunni collections report twelve successors, and a report cited from Ahmad's Musnad compares their number with the twelve chiefs of the Children of Israel. Imami reports name Ali as the first Imam and the Mahdi as the last; eleven of the twelve are Fatimah's descendants.

Sunni reports identify a Mahdi descended from Fatimah ﵍ and separately describe Jesus's ﵇ descent with an imam from the Muslim community. The quoted Imami reports expressly identify the leader behind whom Jesus prays as the Mahdi or Qa'im.

Biblical images and the Prophet's family

Revelation 12 and Genesis 17 do not name Muhammad ﷺ, Ali ﵇, Fatimah ﵍, or the twelve Imams. Identifying the biblical figures with members of the Prophet's family depends on parallels with Islamic reports.
A woman clothed with the sun
In Revelation 12:1, the Arabic transcription quoted here has a form meaning “his wife”; the archived Smith-Van Dyck text reads “a woman.” The Greek and English printed here also read “a woman.”
The woman's child is taken to God and his throne. The dragon then attacks her remaining offspring, who keep God's commandments and bear witness to Jesus.
Revelation 12:9 identifies the dragon as Satan.
Catholic readings of the woman

Pope Pius XII, defining the Assumption of Mary in 1950, wrote that the scholastic doctors recognized the Assumption as signified in "that woman clothed with the sun whom John the Apostle contemplated on the Island of Patmos"
The Catholic Encyclopedia states, "The woman in travail is a personification of the synagogue or the church. Her first-born is Christ, her other seed is the community of the faithful"
The same article connects the sun, moon, and twelve stars with Joseph's dream in Genesis 37:9-10.
In Joseph's dream, the sun, moon, and eleven stars bow to him (Genesis 37:9-10). Revelation has twelve stars and depicts a woman with a child.
An oath by the sun and the moon
In the moon clause, tala means “to follow.” Al-Qummi transmits Abu Basir's report of al-Sadiq's interpretation.

In the report transmitted by al-Qummi, al-Sadiq identifies the sun with Muhammad ﷺ and the moon with Ali ﵇. The day represents an Imam from Fatimah's descendants who explains the Prophet's religion. Furat transmits a report attributed to al-Husayn that identifies the day specifically with the Qa'im, the Imam who will fill the earth with justice.

Al-Kafi also transmits the sun-and-moon interpretation in its Rawda volume. Furat preserves versions attributed to Ibn Abbas, and Ibn Shahrashub includes related interpretations attributed to al-Baqir and al-Sadiq. Ta'wil al-Ayat preserves a different interpretation.

In this version, the sun is Ali ﵇, the moon represents al-Hasan and al-Husayn ﵈, and the heaven is Muhammad ﷺ. Al-Astarabadi transmits it through two chains in Ta'wil al-Ayat. Al-Burhan and Bihar al-Anwar reproduce his report.
The lights of one house
A report in al-Saduq's Ma'ani al-Akhbar associates Venus with Fatimah and the two Farqads with Hasan and Husayn.
Al-Safuri includes the report in Nuzhat al-Majalis, citing Ara'is. Ibn Shahrashub also attributes it to al-Natanzi's al-Khasa'is.
In Salman's report, transmitted by al-Khazzaz, the shining stars are nine Imams descended from al-Husayn.

Salman's report lists twelve successors and compares their number with Jacob's tribes and Jesus's apostles. Its celestial images distinguish Ali as the moon, Hasan and Husayn as the two Farqads, and nine later Imams as shining stars. Revelation instead gives the woman a crown of twelve stars. Identifying that crown with all twelve Imams therefore assigns Ali a place among the stars as well as the moon. The quoted Islamic reports do not make that identification.
Al-Qummi's report from al-Baqir interprets Joseph's dream through Joseph's own family.
The sun represents Joseph's mother, the moon Jacob, and the eleven stars his brothers.
The Fatimah reading and its history

Baydun describes the crown as Fatimah's twelve infallible sons, beginning with Hasan and Husayn. The Imami sequence quoted here contains eleven of her descendants and her husband, Ali, so his wording does not match that count. Baydun cites chapter 11 for a quotation from Revelation 12:1. Al-Yazdi al-Ha'iri gives a longer interpretation in Ilzam al-Nasib. His paraphrase includes mountains being lowered and rough places made smooth, clauses absent from Revelation 12.

Al-Ha'iri identifies the dragon with Banu Umayyah, the child with the hidden Qa'im, and the iron rod with his sword. He rejects the identification of the child with Jesus on the ground that Jesus never fought. In his other mapping, Muhammad, Ali, and ten descendants form the twelve stars, and the Qa'im is the moon.
Twelve princes from the seed of Ishmael
Islamic genealogy traces Muhammad ﷺ to Ishmael. Al-Nu'mani records an interpretation connecting Ishmael's twelve princes with twelve Imams.
Al-Rawandi also relates the blessing of Ishmael to Muhammad ﷺ.
Majlisi, writing in the seventeenth century, says he heard the Hebrew passage read and translated by People of the Book whom he trusted.

Majlisi says that the reports suggest that “Madmad” is Muhammad's ﷺ name in Hebrew. Bihar also transmits a narrative in which Abraham is told that Muhammad's family will descend from his firstborn, Ishmael.

Majlisi quotes this narrative from Ibn Tawus's Iqbal al-A'mal. Ibn Tawus names Abu al-Mufaddal al-Shaybani's book on the mutual imprecation and al-Hasan ibn Isma'il ibn Ashnas's work on the observances of Dhu al-Hijja among his sources.

Genesis 25:13-16 identifies twelve princes as Ishmael's sons. Al-Nu'mani's application to the Imams treats the promise as extending to later descendants of Ishmael. He reports a Jewish scholar's dictation transmitted to him through Abd al-Halim ibn al-Husayn al-Samuri; this passage gives no chain to an Imam.
Twelve Imams in their own reports
Al-Kafi reports that Jabir saw a tablet in Fatimah's hands naming members of her family and their successors.

According to the Tablet report, Jabir copied its text and al-Baqir recited it in agreement with his copy. The text describes a sequence of successors ending with “Mim Ha Mim Dal,” the letters of the name Muhammad. Versions also appear in al-Saduq's Kamal al-Din and Uyun Akhbar al-Rida; al-Hurr al-Amili additionally lists a version in al-Tusi's Ghayba.
Al-Hurr al-Amili notes that al-Khazzaz transmits this report from Ibn Babawayh through the same chain.
Al-Saduq cites reports transmitted by Sunni traditionists as support for the Imami count of twelve.
The nuqaba are the twelve chiefs of the Children of Israel. A report in al-Kafi also compares Muhammad's twelve trustees with the twelve trustees of Jesus.
Another report in al-Kafi attributes the succession testimony to a visitor whom Ali ﵇ identifies as al-Khidr. He names the first eleven Imams and identifies the twelfth by descent.
A kunyah is a byname such as Abu so-and-so. The report says that the twelfth is neither named nor called by a kunyah until his affair becomes manifest.
Twelve caliphs in the Sunni canon
Sahih Muslim transmits Jabir ibn Samura's report of twelve caliphs from Quraysh through several chains.

The anthology Ahadith al-Mahdi min Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal transmits Ibn Mas'ud's report comparing twelve caliphs with the twelve chiefs of the Children of Israel, citing Musnad Ahmad, vol. 1, p. 398.

In Abu Dawud's chapter on the Mahdi, the quoted report gives the ruler's father the Prophet's father's name. This does not match the Imami identification of the Mahdi as the son of al-Hasan. Al-Kanji, as quoted in Sharh Ihqaq al-Haqq, discusses attempts to reconcile the clause, calls that interpretation strained, and appeals to Ahmad's transmissions without it (vol. 33, pp. 943-944).

Al-Nawawi quotes al-Qadi Iyad's distinction between the thirty years of prophetic caliphate and the twelve rulers, for whom no such condition is stated. Al-Qadi also argues that a prediction of twelve rulers permits later rulers. Kanz al-Ummal transmits a report attributed to Ibn Abbas. It places al-Mansur, al-Saffah, and the Mahdi after twelve commanders. The Mahdi would then hand authority to Jesus.
The king who reigns in righteousness
Isaiah 32:1 describes a king who reigns in righteousness, with princes who rule in judgment.

Before Pilate, Jesus ﵇ says that his kingdom is not from this world and that his servants are not fighting to prevent his surrender. This statement does not exclude a future reign on earth. On a reading that requires worldwide peace and a public reign of justice, the prophetic promises extend beyond the events of Jesus's earthly ministry.

Van den Biesen affirms Christ's future return. He also presents Augustine's interpretation of Revelation's thousand-year reign as the Church's present spiritual life (Catholic Encyclopedia, “Apocalypse,” 1907, “Purpose of the book”).

What it promises

God judges among the nations; weapons become farming tools, and nations cease learning war
Isaiah 11:1-9
A ruler from Jesse's line judges the poor and slays the wicked; there is freedom from harm on the holy mountain, and the earth is full of the knowledge of God
A righteous Branch from David's line executes justice, and Israel returns to its land. Judah is saved, Israel dwells safely in chapter 23, and Jerusalem dwells safely in chapter 33
Ezekiel 37:21-28
Israel is gathered into one nation under David as king and shepherd, with God's sanctuary among them forever
Hosea 3:5
Israel returns and seeks the Lord and David their king in the latter days
Psalm 72
The king judges the poor, crushes the oppressor, rules to the ends of the earth, and brings abundance and peace while the moon endures
God establishes an enduring kingdom that displaces the kingdoms in the vision; one like a son of man receives dominion, and the holy people receive the kingdom
The ruler who fills the earth with justice
Reports in Sunan Abi Dawud describe the Mahdi as a descendant of Fatimah who will fill the earth with justice.
A report in Ibn al-Munadi's al-Malahim describes equal distribution of wealth during the Mahdi's reign.
Psalm 72 describes a king who judges the poor, defeats oppressors, and brings abundance and peace. The Mahdi reports likewise describe justice and material sufficiency.
The report attributed to Ahmad leaves the imam unnamed. The Imami report attributed to Ibn Abbas identifies the Mahdi as the last of twelve successors and says that Jesus will pray behind him.
Uyun Akhbar al-Rida attributes the same prediction of Jesus praying behind the Mahdi to al-Rida in a discussion with al-Ma'mun.
In the report attributed to al-Hasan, God conceals the Qa'im's birth so that he will owe no allegiance to the ruler of his time when he emerges.

Isaiah 11 describes a ruler from Jesse's line, and Jeremiah 23 names David's line. The Mahdi reports quoted here identify him through Muhammad's ﷺ and Fatimah's ﵍ line. The Imami prediction that Jesus ﵇ will pray behind the Mahdi distinguishes the two figures, but it does not identify the Mahdi as David's descendant or explicitly assign him every office described in these biblical passages.
Final Verdict
Final Verdict

These biblical passages and Imami reports share celestial imagery, a count of twelve, and descriptions of just rule. Applying the biblical figures to Fatimah ﵍, the Imams, and the Mahdi remains an interpretation. The twelve-star crown differs from the Islamic reports' distribution of symbols, Genesis identifies Ishmael's twelve princes as his sons, and Isaiah and Jeremiah specify Jesse's or David's line.

paragraphs.text: (باب) (معنى الشمس والقمر والزهرة والفرقدين) 1 - حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمر [و] بن علي بن عبد الله البصري ، قال : حدثنا أبو بكر عبد الله بن علي الكرخي ، قال : حدثنا أبو بكر محمد بن عبد الله ، قال : حدثنا أبي قال : حدثنا عبد الرزاق الصنعاني ، قال : حدثنا معمر ، عن الزهري ، عن أنس بن مالك قال : صلى رسول الله ﵌ صلاة الفجر ، فلما انفتل من صلاته أقبل علينا بوجهه الكريم على الله ﷿ ثم قال : معاشر الناس من افتقد الشمس فليستمسك بالقمر ، ومن افتقد القمر فليستمسك بالزهرة ، فمن افتقد الزهرة فليستمسك (2) بالفرقدين . ثم قال رسول الله ﵌ : أنا الشمس ، وعلي القمر ، وفاطمة الزهرة ، والحسن والحسين الفرقدان . وكتاب الله لا يفترقان حتى يردا علي الحوض . - 2 حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمر [و] البصري ، قال : حدثنا أبو القاسم نصر بن الحسين الصفار النهاوندي بها ، قال : حدثنا أبو الفرج أحمد بن محمد بن خوزي السامري ، قال : حدثنا أبو بكر القاسم بن إبراهيم القنطري ، قال : حدثنا إبراهيم بن خالد الحلواني ، قال حدثنا محمد بن خلف العسقلاني ، قال : حدثنا محمد بن السري ، عن محمد بن المنكدر ، عن جابر بن عبد الله ، قال . قال رسول الله ﵌ : اقتدوا بالشمس فإذا غابت الشمس فاقتدوا

بالقمر ، فإذا غاب القمر فاقتدوا بالزهرة فإذا غابت الزهرة فاقتدوا بالفرقدين فقالوا : يا رسول الله فما الشمس ؟ وما القمر ؟ وما الزهرة ؟ وما الفرقدان ؟ فقال : أنا الشمس ، وعلي القمر ، والزهرة فاطمة ، والفرقدان الحسن والحسين
Chapter on the meaning of the sun, the moon, Venus, and the two Farqads

Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Abd Allah al-Basri narrated to us. He said that Abu Bakr Abd Allah ibn Ali al-Karkhi narrated to us. He said that Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Abd Allah narrated to us. He said that his father narrated to us. He said that Abd al-Razzaq al-San'ani narrated to us from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Anas ibn Malik, who said

The Messenger of God performed the dawn prayer. When he had turned away after his prayer, he turned toward us with his face, honored in the sight of God, Mighty and Majestic, and said, "People, whoever loses the sun should hold fast to the moon. Whoever loses the moon should hold fast to Venus. Whoever loses Venus should hold fast to the two Farqads."

Then the Messenger of God said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, Fatima is Venus, and Hasan and Husayn are the two Farqads. They and the Book of God will not separate until they come to me at the Pool."

Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Umar al-Basri narrated to us. He said that Abu al-Qasim Nasr ibn al-Husayn al-Saffar al-Nahawandi narrated to us there. He said that Abu al-Faraj Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khuwayzi al-Samiri narrated to us. He said that Abu Bakr al-Qasim ibn Ibrahim al-Qantari narrated to us. He said that Ibrahim ibn Khalid al-Hulwani narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn Khalaf al-Asqalani narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn al-Sari narrated to us from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said

The Messenger of God said, "Follow the sun. When the sun sets, follow the moon. When the moon disappears, follow Venus. When Venus disappears, follow the two Farqad stars." They said, "Messenger of God, what are the sun, the moon, Venus, and the two Farqad stars?" He said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, Venus is Fatimah, and the two Farqad stars are Hasan and Husayn."

quotes.caption: - The Prophet, Nuzhat al-Majalis, vol. 2, p. 315, citing Ara'is

paragraphs.text: وفي حديث آخر : «من افتقد الشمس فليتمسك بالقمر ومن افتقد القمر فليتمسك بالزهرة ومن افتقد الزهرة فليتمسك بالفرقدين فسئل عن ذلك فقال : أنا الشمس وعلي القمر والزهرة فاطمة والفرقدان الحسن والحسين ﵃» ذكره في العرائس
In another report, "Whoever loses the sun should hold fast to the moon. Whoever loses the moon should hold fast to Venus. Whoever loses Venus should hold fast to the two Farqads."
He was asked about this and said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, Venus is Fatimah, and the two Farqads are Hasan and Husayn."
He mentioned it in al-Ara'is.

quotes.caption: - The Prophet, Kifayat al-Athar, pp. 65-66, Salman's report

paragraphs.text: معاشر الناس من افتقد الشمس فليتمسك بالقمر ، ومن افتقد القمر فليتمسك بالفرقدين ، فإذا فقدتم الفرقدين فتمسكوا بالنجوم الزاهرة بعدي ، أقول قولي هذا وأستغفر الله لي ولكم . قال : فلما نزل عن المنبر ﵌ تبعته حتى دخل بيت عائشة ، فدخلت إليه وقلت : بأبي أنت وأمي يا رسول الله سمعتك تقول " إذا افتقدتم الشمس فتمسكوا بالقمر ، وإذا افتقدتم القمر فتمسكوا بالفرقدين ، وإذا افتقدتم الفرقدين فتمسكوا بالنجوم الزاهرة " فما الشمس وما القمر وما الفرقدان وما النجوم الزاهرة ؟ فقال : [أنا الشمس (2) وعلي القمر والحسن والحسين الفرقدان ، فإذا افتقدتموني فتمسكوا بعلي بعدي ، وإذا افتقدتموه فتمسكوا بالحسن والحسين] ، وأما النجوم الزاهرة فهم الأئمة (3) التسعة (4)

من صلب الحسين ، تاسعهم (1) مهديهم . ثم قال ﵇ : إنهم هم الأوصياء والخلفاء بعدي ، أئمة أبرار ، عدد أسباط يعقوب وحواري عيسى . قلت : فسمهم لي يا رسول الله ؟ قال : أولهم (2) علي بن أبي طالب ، وبعده (3) سبطاي ، وبعدهما علي (4) زين العابدين ، وبعده محمد بن علي الباقر (5) علم النبيين والصادق (6) جعفر بن محمد وابنه الكاظم سمي موسى بن عمران والذي يقتل بأرض الغربة (7) ابنه (8) علي ثم ابنه محمد (9) والصادقان علي والحسن والحجة القائم المنتظر في غيبته ، فإنهم عترتي من دمي ولحمي ، علمهم علمي وحكمهم حكمي ، من آذاني فيهم فلا أناله الله (10) شفاعتي .

"People, whoever loses the sun, let him hold fast to the moon. Whoever loses the moon, let him hold fast to the two Farqads. When you lose the two Farqads, hold fast after me to the shining stars. I say these words of mine and ask God to forgive me and you."

He said, “When he came down from the pulpit, I followed him until he entered the house of Aisha. I entered upon him and said, ‘May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of God. I heard you say, "When you lose the sun, hold fast to the moon. When you lose the moon, hold fast to the two Farqads. When you lose the two Farqads, hold fast to the shining stars." What are the sun, the moon, the two Farqads, and the shining stars?’”

He said, "I am the sun, Ali is the moon, and Hasan and Husayn are the two Farqads. When you lose me, hold fast after me to Ali. When you lose him, hold fast to Hasan and Husayn. As for the shining stars, they are the nine Imams from the loins of Husayn, the ninth of whom is their Mahdi."
Then he said, "They are the legatees and caliphs after me, righteous Imams, equal in number to the tribes of Yaqub and the apostles of Isa."
I said, "Name them for me, O Messenger of God."

He said, "The first of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib. After him are my two grandsons. After them are Ali Zayn al-Abidin, then Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, who unfolds the knowledge of the prophets, al-Sadiq Jafar ibn Muhammad, his son al-Kazim, the namesake of Musa ibn Imran, and the one who will be killed in the land of exile, his son Ali, then his son Muhammad, the two truthful ones Ali and Hasan, and the Proof, the Qa'im awaited during his occultation. They are my progeny, of my blood and flesh. Their knowledge is my knowledge, and their judgment is my judgment. Whoever hurts me through them, may God not grant him my intercession."

quotes.caption: - Imam al-Baqir, Tafsir al-Qummi, vol. 1, p. 365, Abu al-Jarud's report

paragraphs.text: ثم قص قصة يوسف لأبيه (يا أبت اني رأيت أحد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رأيتهم لي ساجدين) حدثنا محمد بن جعفر قال حدثنا محمد بن أحمد قال حدثنا علي بن محمد عمن حدثه عن المنقري عن عمرو بن شمر عن إسماعيل السندي عن عبد الرحمن ابن سابط القرشي عن جابر بن عبد الله الأنصاري في قول الله ﷿ " اني رأيت أحد عشر كوكبا والشمس والقمر رأيتهم لي ساجدين " قال في تسمية النجوم هو الطارق وحوبان والذيال (الدبال ك) وذو الكتفين (ذو الكنفين ط) ووثاب وقابس وعمودان وفليق (فيلق) ومصبح والصرح والفروع (والقروع) والضياء والنور يعني الشمس والقمر وكل هذه النجوم محيطة بالسماء ، وفي رواية أبي الجارود عن أبي جعفر ﵇ قال تأويل هذه الرؤيا انه سيملك مصر ويدخل عليه أبواه واخوته ، اما الشمس فأم يوسف راحيل والقمر يعقوب واما أحد عشر كوكبا فاخوته ، فلما دخلوا عليه سجدوا شكرا لله وحده حين نظروا إليه وكان ذلك السجود لله .
Then he related Joseph's story to his father. "My father, I saw eleven stars, and the sun and the moon. I saw them prostrating themselves before me."

Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to us. He said that Ali ibn Muhammad narrated to us from one who narrated to him, from al-Minqari, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Isma'il al-Sindi, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit al-Qurashi, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, concerning the saying of God, "I saw eleven stars, and the sun and the moon. I saw them prostrating themselves before me."

He said concerning the names of the stars, "They are al-Tariq, Hawban, al-Dhiyal, al-Dibbal in K, Dhu al-Katifayn, Dhu al-Kanafayn in T, Waththab, Qabis, Amudan, Faliq, Faylaq, Musbih, al-Sarh, al-Furu', al-Quru' in the variant reading, al-Diya', and al-Nur, meaning the sun and the moon. All these stars surround the sky."

In the report of Abu al-Jarud from Abu Ja'far, he said, "The interpretation of this vision is that he will rule Egypt, and his parents and brothers will enter upon him. The sun was Joseph's mother Rachel, the moon was Jacob, and the eleven stars were his brothers. When they entered upon him, they prostrated in thanks to God alone when they saw him. That prostration was for God."

quotes.caption: - Labib Baydun, Mawsu'at Karbala, vol. 1, p. 131

paragraphs.text: 45 - الإنجيل يتنبّأ بالأئمة الاثني عشر : جاء في الإصحاح الحادي عشر عن تنبؤات يوحنا اللاهوتي ما نصه : « وظهرت آية عظيمة في السماء ، امرأة متسربلة بالشمس ، وتحت رجليها القمر ، وعلى رأسها إكليل من اثني عشر كوكبا » . فكأنه يتكلم عن مولاتنا فاطمة الزهراء ﵍ وقد تسربلت بالشمس يعني أبيها محمّد ﵌ ، وتزوجت بالقمر وهو علي بن أبي طالب ﵇ ، وعلى رأسها إكليل من أبنائها المعصومين الاثني عشر ، الذين أولهم الحسن والحسين وآخرهم المهدي ﵇ . وليس هناك فيما تنبّأ به يوحنا اللاهوتي فيما سيحصل من أمور ، شيء شبيه بالذي ذكر ، غير فاطمة وأبيها وبعلها وبنيها ﵈ .
The Gospel foretells the twelve Imams.
In the eleventh chapter, the following occurs among the prophecies of John the Theologian.
"A great sign appeared in heaven, a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars."

It is as though he is speaking of our lady Fatima al-Zahra. She was clothed with the sun, meaning her father Muhammad, and married to the moon, who is Ali ibn Abi Talib. Upon her head is a crown from her twelve infallible sons, the first of whom are al-Hasan and al-Husayn and the last of whom is the Mahdi.
Among what John the Theologian foretold would occur, there is nothing resembling what he mentioned except Fatima, her father, her husband, and her sons.

quotes.caption: - Al-Yazdi al-Ha'iri, Ilzam al-Nasib, vol. 1, pp. 129-130, p. 129

paragraphs.text: البشارة السابعة عشرة في قوام الأمة عن مكاشفات يوحنا في الباب الثاني عشر في الآية الأولى ما ترجمته : إنه ظهر في السماء علامة وهي امرأة لبست الشمس ، وتحت رجليها القمر ، وعلى رأسها تاج من اثني عشر كوكبا ، فبينما هي حامل وإذا بثعبان سيمتلئ ، وكل جبل وأكمة ستتضع وتعتدل المعوجات وتلين الصعاب ، تلك الكواكب على الأرض والثعبان واقفة عند المرأة الحاملة على الوضع لتأخذ مولودها بعد وضعها ، فوضعت ذكرا سويا يحكم على جميع الطوائف بعصا من حديد ، فاجتلب وأخذ إلى الله وبلغ إلى مقرره وسريره ، انتهى (2) . قال المؤلف : المراد بالامرأة هي فاطمة الزهراء حيث غلبت نورها الشمس ، والقمر تحت رجلها وهي أعلى وأجل ، بل نوره جزء من آلاف جزء من أجزاء نورها ومكتسب منها ، والتاج المشتمل على البروج الاثني عشر الأئمة الاثنا عشر سلام الله عليهم أجمعين ، والمراد من تلك الثعبان شجرة بني أمية ، الشجرة الخبيثة ، قتلت الكواكب المعنوية المشرقة ، والمراد من الطفل هو الإمام القائم (﵇) الغائب ، حيث أراد الأعداء قتله فاختفى وحجب عن الأبصار ، والعصا الحديد كناية عن السيف ، فيقاتل من على وجه الأرض من الطوائف بالسيف ويملأ الأرض قسطا وعدلا ويضمحل وينهدم بنيان الكفر والضلال والظلم ، وليس مراد اليسوع المسيح لأنه (﵇) لم يقاتل قط ، وإنما كان المسيح مظهرا للرحمة ، ويمكن أن يكون المراد من النجوم الاثني عشر محمدا (﵌) وعليا والعشرة من أولاده ، والقمر كناية عن القائم (﵇) ، ولا ينطبق على مريم واليسوع والحواريين ، لأنهم وإن كانوا اثني عشر إلا أنه ارتد واحد منهم فينافي العدد المعلوم .

The seventeenth glad tiding concerning the support of the community is from the Revelations of John, in chapter twelve, verse one. Its translation is as follows. "A sign appeared in heaven. It was a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet and a crown of twelve stars upon her head. While she was pregnant, behold, a serpent will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be lowered, the crooked places will be made straight, and the rough places will become smooth. Those stars are upon the earth, and the serpent stands before the woman who is pregnant and about to give birth, in order to take her child after she gives birth. So she gave birth to a sound male, who rules all the groups with an iron rod. He was carried away and taken to God, and reached His abode and throne." End.

The author said, "What is meant by the woman is Fatimah al-Zahra, for her light surpassed the sun. The moon is beneath her foot, and she is higher and more majestic. Indeed, its light is one part of thousands of parts of portions of her light and is acquired from her. The crown containing the twelve constellations is the twelve Imams, peace be upon them all.

What is meant by that serpent is the tree of Banu Umayyah, the wicked tree. It killed the shining spiritual stars. What is meant by the child is the hidden Imam, the Qa'im. Since the enemies wanted to kill him, he concealed himself and was veiled from sight. The iron rod is a metaphor for the sword. He will fight the groups upon the face of the earth with the sword, fill the earth with equity and justice, and the structure of unbelief, error, and oppression will vanish and collapse. Jesus the Messiah is not meant, because he never fought. Rather, the Messiah was a manifestation of mercy.

It is possible that the twelve stars mean Muhammad, Ali, and ten of his sons, and that the moon is a metaphor for the Qa'im. It does not apply to Mary, Jesus, and the disciples, because although they were twelve, one of them apostatized, which conflicts with the known number."

quotes.caption: - Al-Yazdi al-Ha'iri, Ilzam al-Nasib, vol. 1, pp. 129-130, continued, p. 130

paragraphs.text: وما فسره بعض علماء النصارى من أن المراد من المرأة هي المعبد والكنيسة ، والنجوم الاثني عشر عبارة عن الحوراء الملازمة لها الحافات حولها ، وذلك حيث ذكر في الباب الثاني من المكاشفات أن اكتب للحوراء الموكلة بكنيسة أقس أن من بيده النجوم السبع يسير في المصابيح السبعة المذهبة ، ففيه أن الكنايس لا تشتمل على الحور ولا يناسب ذكر النجم لها أيضا وبعيد جدا ، والتعبير عن الخادم والحارث والحفظة مع ما هم عليه من الظلمة بالنورانية والبهاء أبعد خطأ عند العقلاء .

What some Christian scholars interpreted is that the woman means the temple and the church, and that the twelve stars refer to the maidens attached to her and surrounding her. This is because chapter two of the Apocalypse mentions, "Write to the maiden appointed over the church of Ephesus, that He who holds the seven stars walks among the seven golden lampstands." Yet churches do not contain maidens, nor is it fitting to call her a star. This is very far-fetched. Moreover, to describe the servant, the cultivator, and the guards, despite their darkness, as luminous and radiant is an even more erroneous mistake in the judgment of rational people.

quotes.caption: - Genesis 17:20, Westminster Leningrad Codex, Arabic corpus transcription, King James Version

paragraphs.text: וּֽלְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֮ שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ֒ הִנֵּ֣ה ׀ בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹתֹ֗ו וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹתֹ֛ו וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹתֹ֖ו בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר נְשִׂיאִם֙ יֹולִ֔יד וּנְתַתִּ֖יו לְגֹ֥וי גָּדֹֽול׃
20 وأما إسماعيل فقد سمعت لك فيه . هاأنا أباركه وأثمره وأكثره كثيرا جدا . اثني عشر رئيسا يلد وأجعله أمة كبيرة
"And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation."

quotes.caption: - Al-Nu'mani, Kitab al-Ghayba, p. 108, from a Jewish scholar of Arrajan

paragraphs.text: وقد أجبت دعاءك في إسماعيل ، وقد سمعتك ما باركته ، وسأكثره جدا جدا ، وسيلد اثني عشر عظيما أجعلهم أئمة كشعب عظيم . أقرأني عبد الحليم بن الحسين السمري (﵀) ما أملاه عليه رجل من اليهود بأرجان (1) يقال له الحسين بن سليمان من علماء اليهود بها من أسماء الأئمة (﵈) بالعبرانية وعدتهم ، وقد أثبته على لفظه ، وكان فيما قرأه أنه يبعث من ولد إسماعيل في التوراة اشموعيل يسمى مابد (2) يعني محمدا (﵌) يكون سيدا ، ويكون من آله اثنا عشر رجلا أئمة وسادة يقتدى بهم ، وأسماؤهم : تقوبيت ، فيذوا ، ذبيرا ، مفسورا ، مسموعا ، دوموه ، ثبو ، هذار ، يثمو ، بطور ، نوقس ، قيدموا .

"I have answered your prayer concerning Ishmael. I have heard you and blessed him. I shall multiply him exceedingly, exceedingly. He will father twelve great men, and I shall make them imams for a great people."

Abd al-Halim ibn al-Husayn al-Samuri read to me what a Jewish man in Arrajan, called al-Husayn ibn Sulayman, one of its Jewish scholars, dictated to him concerning the names of the imams in Hebrew and their number. I have recorded it in its own wording. Among what he read was that in the Torah, one will be sent from the descendants of Ishmael, called Ashmu'il, and named Mabad, meaning Muhammad. He will be a master, and from his family will be twelve men, imams and masters to be followed. Their names are Taqwabit, Fidhwa, Dhabira, Mafsura, Masmu'a, Dumuha, Thabu, Hadhar, Yathmu, Batur, Nuqus, and Qayduma.

quotes.caption: - Al-Rawandi, al-Kharaij wa-l-Jara'ih, vol. 1, p. 77

paragraphs.text: منها ألفاظ التوراة في هذا الباب في السفر الأول منه : " إن الملك نزل على إبراهيم فقال له : إنه يولد في هذا العالم لك غلام اسمه إسحاق . فقال إبراهيم : ليت إسماعيل يعيش بين أيديك بخدمتك . فقال الله لإبراهيم : لك ذلك ، قد استجبت في إسماعيل ، وإني أبركه وآمنه وأعظمه بما استجبت فيه " . وتفسير هذا الحرف : محمد ﵌ [وفيه أيضا مكتوب : " وأما ابن الأمة فقد باركت عليه جدا جدا] (1) ويلد اثني عشر عظيما ، وأصيره لامة كثيرة " .
Among the words of the Torah on this subject, in its first book, are the following.

"The angel came down to Abraham and said to him, 'A boy named Isaac will be born to you in this world.' Abraham said, 'Would that Ishmael might live before You in Your service.' God said to Abraham, 'That shall be yours. I have answered you concerning Ishmael. I shall bless him, secure him, and make him great through what I have answered concerning him.'"

The interpretation of this word is Muhammad. It is also written in it, "As for the son of the slave woman, I have blessed him exceedingly, exceedingly. He will beget twelve great ones, and I shall make him into a great nation."

quotes.caption: - Al-Suddi's tafsir, quoted in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 36, p. 216, with Majlisi's comments, p. 216

paragraphs.text: انطلق بإسماعيل وأمة حتى تنزله بيت التهامي - يعني مكة - فإني ناشر ذريته وجاعلهم ثقلا على من كفر بي ، وجاعل منهم نبيا عظيما ، ومظهره على الأديان ، وجاعل من ذريته اثني عشر عظيما ، وجاعل ذريته عدد نجوم السماء (5) . أقول : سمعت من جماعة من ثقات أهل الكتاب أنه موجود في توراتهم الآن " وليشمعيل شمعتيك هينه برختي اوتو وهيفريتي اوتو وهيبريتى (6) اوتو بماود ماود شنيم عاسار نسيئيم يوليدو نتيتو لكوى كدول " وسمعتهم يترجمونه هكذا : ومن إسماعيل أسمعتك أني باركت إياه وأوفرت إياه وأكثرت إياه في غاية الغاية اثني عشر رؤساء يولدون ، ووهبته قوما عظيما .

Set out with Ishmael and his mother until you bring them down to the house of the Tihamah, meaning Mecca. For I will spread his descendants abroad, make them a burden upon whoever disbelieves in Me, raise from them a great prophet, make him manifest over the religions, make twelve great ones from his descendants, and make his descendants as numerous as the stars of heaven.

I say, I heard from a group of trustworthy People of the Book that this is now found in their Torah. "Ule-Yishmael shematikha, hinneh berakhti oto, vehifreti oto vehirbeiti oto bimeod meod, shenem asar nesi'im yolid, netativ legoy gadol." I heard them translate it as follows. "And concerning Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, made him fruitful, and multiplied him exceedingly, exceedingly. Twelve chiefs will be born, and I have given him to a great people."

quotes.caption: - Al-Suddi's tafsir, quoted in Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 36, p. 216, with Majlisi's comments, continued, p. 216

paragraphs.text: أقول : الذي يظهر من الاخبار أن " مادماد " اسم محمد ﵌ بالعبرانية
I say that what appears from the reports is that "Madmad" is the Hebrew name of Muhammad.

quotes.caption: - Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 21, pp. 317-318, from Ibn Tawus, Iqbal al-A'mal

paragraphs.text: فقال : رب صلى على محمد وآل محمد ، كما اجتبيتهم وأخلصتهم إخلاصا ، فأوحى ﷿ ليهنئك (1) كرامتي وفضلي عليك ، فإني صائر بسلالة محمد ومن اصطفيت معه منهم إلى قناة صلبك ، ومخرجهم منك ، ثم من بكرك إسماعيل ﵇ ، فأبشر يا إبراهيم فإني واصل صلواتك بصلواتهم ، ومتبع ذلك بركاتي وترحمي عليك وعليهم ، وجاعل حناني (2) وحجتي إلى الأمد المعدود واليوم الموعود الذي أرث فيه سمائي وأرضي ، وأبعث له خلقي بفصل قضائي (3) وإفاضة رحمتي وعدلي . قال : فلما سمع أصحاب رسول الله ﵌ ما أفضى إليه القوم من تلاوة ما تضمنت الجامعة والصحف الدارسة من نعت رسول الله ﵌ وصفة أهل بيته المذكورين معه بما هم به منه وبما شاهدوا من مكانتهم عنده ازداد القوم بذلك يقينا وإيمانا ، واستطيروا له فرحا . قال : ثم صار القوم إلى ما نزل على موسى ﵇ فألفوا في السفر الثاني من التوراة : إني باعث في الأميين من ولد إسماعيل رسولا أنزل عليه كتابي وأبعثه بالشريعة القيمة إلى جميع خلقي ، أوتيه حكمتي ، وأؤيده بملائكتي (4) وجنودي تكون ذريته من ابنة له مباركة باركتها ، ثم من شبلين لها كإسماعيل وإسحاق أصلين لشعبين عظيمين (5) أكثرهم جدا جدا ، يكون منهم اثنا عشر قيما ، أكمل بمحمد ﵌ وبما أرسله به من بلاغ وحكمة ديني وأختم به أنبيائي ورسلي ، فعلى محمد وأمته تقوم الساعة .
He said, "My Lord, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You have chosen them and made them wholly sincere."

Then the Most High revealed, "Let My honor and My favor upon you give you glad tidings. I shall bring the progeny of Muhammad and those whom I have chosen with him from among them to the channel of your loins. I shall bring them forth from you, then from your firstborn Ishmael. So rejoice, Abraham. I shall join your blessings to their blessings, and I shall follow that with My blessings and My mercy upon you and upon them. I shall make My tenderness and My proof endure until the numbered term and the promised day, when I inherit My heaven and My earth and raise My creatures for the decisive execution of My judgment and the outpouring of My mercy and justice."

He said that when the companions of the Messenger of God heard what the people had disclosed by reciting what the comprehensive book and the worn scrolls contained concerning the description of the Messenger of God and the description of his household, who were mentioned with him, concerning what they were to him and what they witnessed of their rank with Him, the people increased thereby in certainty and faith, and their joy over it soared.

He said that the people then turned to what had been sent down to Moses. In the second book of the Torah they found, "I shall send among the unlettered people, from the descendants of Ishmael, a messenger upon whom I shall send down My Book. I shall send him with the upright law to all My creatures. I shall give him My wisdom and support him with My angels and My troops. His descendants will be from a blessed daughter whom I have blessed, then from her two cubs, like Ishmael and Isaac, the roots of two great peoples. I shall multiply them exceedingly, exceedingly. Among them will be twelve guardians. Through Muhammad and the message and wisdom with which I send him, I shall complete My religion and seal My prophets and messengers with him. The Hour will come upon Muhammad and his community."

quotes.caption: - Fatimah and Jabir, al-Kafi, vol. 1, pp. 575-576, hadith of the Tablet

paragraphs.text: 3 - محمد بن يحيى ومحمد بن عبد الله ، عن عبد الله بن جعفر ، عن الحسن بن ظريف وعلي بن محمد ، عن صالح بن أبي حماد ، عن بكر بن صالح ، عن عبد الرحمن بن سالم ، عن أبي بصير ، عن أبي عبد الله ﵇ قال : قال أبي لجابر بن عبد الله الأنصاري إن لي إليك حاجة فمتى يخف عليك أن أخلو بك فأسألك عنها ، فقال له جابر : أي الأوقات أحببته فخلا به في بعض الأيام فقال له : يا جابر أخبرني عن اللوح الذي رأيته في يد أمي فاطمة ﵍ بنت رسول الله ﵌ وما أخبرتك به أمي أنه في ذلك اللوح مكتوب ؟ فقال جابر : أشهد بالله أني دخلت على أمك فاطمة ﵍ في حياة رسول الله ﵌ فهنيتها بولادة الحسين ورأيت في يديها لوحا أخضر ، ظننت أنه من زمرد ورأيت فيه كتابا أبيض ، شبه لون الشمس ، فقلت لها : بأبي وأمي يا بنت رسول الله ﵌ ما هذا اللوح ؟ فقالت : هذا لوح أهداه الله إلى رسول الله ﵌ فيه اسم أبي واسم بعلي واسم ابني واسم الأوصياء من ولدي وأعطانيه أبي ليبشرني بذلك ، قال جابر فأعطتنيه أمك فاطمة ﵍ فقرأته واستنسخته ، فقال له أبي : فهل لك يا جابر : أن تعرضه علي قال : نعم ، فمشى معه أبي إلى منزل جابر فأخرج صحيفة من رق (1) ، فقال : يا جابر انظر في كتابك لأقرأ [أنا] عليك ، فنظر جابر في نسخته فقرأه أبي فما خالف حرف حرفا ، فقال جابر : فأشهد بالله أني هكذا رأيته في اللوح مكتوبا . بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هذا كتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم لمحمد نبيه ونوره وسفيره وحجابه ودليله نزل به الروح الأمين من عند رب العالمين ، عظم يا محمد أسمائي واشكر نعمائي ولا تجحد آلائي ، إني أنا الله إله إلا أنا قاصم الجبارين ومديل المظلومين وديان الدين ، إني أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا ، فمن رجا غير فضلي أو خاف غير عدلي ، عذبته عذابا لا أعذبه (2) أحدا من العالمين فإياي فاعبد وعلي فتوكل ، إني لم أبعث نبيا فأكملت أيامه وانقضت مدته إلا جعلت له وصيا وإني فضلتك على الأنبياء وفضلت وصيك على الأوصياء وأكرمتك بشبليك (3) وسبطيك حسن وحسين ، فجعلت حسنا معدن علمي ،

بعد انقضاء مدة أبيه وجعلت حسينا خازن وحيي وأكرمته بالشهادة وختمت له بالسعادة ، فهو أفضل من استشهد وأرفع الشهداء درجة ، جعلت كلمتي التامة معه وحجتي البالغة عنده ، بعترته أثيب وأعاقب ، أولهم علي سيد العابدين وزين أوليائي الماضين (1) وابنه شبه جده المحمود محمد الباقر علمي والمعدن لحكمتي سيهلك المرتابون في جعفر ، الراد عليه كالراد علي ، حق القول مني لأكرمن مثوى جعفر ولاسرنه في أشياعه وأنصاره وأوليائه ، أتيحت (2) بعده موسى فتنة عمياء حندس لان خيط فرضي لا ينقطع وحجتي لا تخفى وأن أوليائي يسقون بالكأس الأوفى ، من جحد واحدا منهم فقد جحد نعمتي ومن غير آية من كتابي فقد افترى علي ، ويل للمفترين الجاحدين عند انقضاء مدة موسى عبدي وحبيبي وخيرتي في علي وليي وناصري ومن أضع عليه أعباء النبوة وأمتحنه بالاضطلاع بها يقتله عفريت مستكبر يدفن في المدينة التي بناها العبد الصالح (3) إلى جنب شر خلقي حق القول مني لأسرنه بمحمد ابنه وخليفته من بعده ووارث علمه ، فهو معدن علمي وموضع سري وحجتي على خلقي لا يؤمن عبد به إلا جعلت الجنة مثواه وشفعته في سبعين من أهل بيته كلهم قد استوجبوا النار وأختم بالسعادة لابنه علي وليي وناصري والشاهد في خلقي وأميني علي وحيي ، أخرج منه الداعي إلى سبيلي والخازن لعلمي الحسن وأكمل ذلك بابنه " م ح م د " رحمة للعالمين ، عليه كمال موسى وبهاء عيسى وصبر أيوب فيذل أوليائي في زمانه وتتهادى رؤوسهم كما تتهادى رؤوس الترك والديلم فيقتلون ويحرقون ويكونون خائفين ، مرعوبين ، وجلين ، تصبغ الأرض بدمائهم ويفشو الويل والرنا في نسائهم أولئك أوليائي حقا ، بهم أدفع كل فتنة عمياء حندس وبهم أكشف الزلازل وأدفع الآصار والاغلال أولئك عليهم صلوات من ربهم ورحمة وأولئك هم المهتدون . قال عبد الرحمن بن سالم : قال أبو بصير : لو لم تسمع في دهرك ، إلا هذا الحديث لكفاك ، فصنه إلا عن أهله .

Muhammad ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Abd Allah narrated from Abd Allah ibn Ja'far, from al-Hasan ibn Zarif and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abd Allah, who said
My father said to Jabir ibn Abd Allah al-Ansari, "I have a need to ask of you. When would it be convenient for you for me to be alone with you and ask you about it?"
Jabir said to him, "Whenever you wish."

One day he was alone with him, and he said, "O Jabir, tell me about the tablet that you saw in the hand of my mother Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of God, and about what my mother told you was written on that tablet."

Jabir said, "I bear witness by God that I entered upon your mother Fatima during the lifetime of the Messenger of God and congratulated her on the birth of al-Husayn. I saw in her hands a green tablet, which I thought was made of emerald, and I saw on it white writing, like the color of the sun. I said to her, 'May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O daughter of the Messenger of God, what is this tablet?'"

She said, "This is a tablet that God gave as a gift to the Messenger of God. It contains the name of my father, the name of my husband, the name of my son, and the names of the trustees from among my descendants. My father gave it to me to bring me glad tidings through it."
Jabir said, "Then your mother Fatima gave it to me, and I read it and copied it."
My father said to him, "O Jabir, would you show it to me?"

He said, "Yes." My father walked with him to Jabir's house, and he brought out a sheet of parchment. He said, "O Jabir, look at your writing so that I may read it to you." Jabir looked at his copy, and my father read it. Not one letter differed from another letter.
Jabir said, "I bear witness by God that this is how I saw it written on the tablet."

In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. This is a writing from God, the Mighty, the Wise, to Muhammad, His prophet, His light, His messenger, His veil, and His guide. The Trustworthy Spirit brought it down from the Lord of the worlds.

Magnify My names, O Muhammad. Give thanks for My blessings, and do not deny My favors. I am God. There is no god but I. I crush the tyrants, grant victory to the oppressed, and judge on the Day of Judgment. I am God. There is no god but I. Whoever hopes for other than My grace or fears other than My justice, I will punish with a punishment by which I will punish no one among the worlds. So worship Me and rely upon Me.

I did not send a prophet whose days were completed and whose term came to an end without appointing for him a trustee. I favored you above the prophets, favored your trustee above the trustees, and honored you through your two grandsons and descendants, Hasan and Husayn. I made Hasan a repository of My knowledge, after his father's term came to an end. I made Husayn the keeper of My revelation. I honored him with martyrdom and sealed his life with happiness. He is the best of those martyred and the martyr of the highest rank. I placed My complete word with him and My conclusive proof with him. Through his progeny I reward and punish.

The first of them is Ali, master of the worshippers and adornment of My former saints. His son Muhammad, who opens My knowledge and is the repository of My wisdom, resembles his praiseworthy grandfather. Those who doubt concerning Jafar will perish. Whoever rejects him is like one who rejects Me. My word is binding that I will honor Jafar's dwelling place and make him happy through his followers, supporters, and friends.

After him Musa will face a blind, dark trial, because the thread of My obligation does not break, My proof is not concealed, and My saints are given the fullest cup to drink. Whoever denies one of them has denied My blessing. Whoever alters a verse of My Book has fabricated a lie against Me. Woe to the lying deniers when the term of Musa, My servant, beloved, and chosen one, comes to an end, concerning Ali, My friend and helper, upon whom I place the burdens of prophethood and whom I test by having him bear them. An arrogant demon will kill him. He will be buried in the city built by the righteous servant, beside the worst of My creatures.

My word is binding that I will make him happy through Muhammad, his son, his successor after him, and the heir to his knowledge. He is the repository of My knowledge, the place of My secret, and My proof over My creatures. No servant believes in him without My making Paradise his dwelling place and accepting his intercession for seventy members of his household, all of whom have deserved the Fire.

I will seal with happiness his son Ali, My friend and helper, the witness among My creatures, and My trustee over My revelation. From him I will bring forth the caller to My path and the keeper of My knowledge, Hasan. I will complete that through his son Mim Ha Mim Dal, a mercy to the worlds. He will have the perfection of Musa, the splendor of Isa, and the patience of Ayyub.

My saints will be humiliated in his time. Their heads will be passed from hand to hand as the heads of the Turks and Daylamites are passed from hand to hand. They will be killed and burned. They will be afraid, terrified, and fearful. The earth will be stained with their blood, and wailing and lamentation will spread among their women. Those are truly My saints. Through them I repel every blind, dark trial. Through them I avert earthquakes and repel burdens and shackles. Upon them are blessings and mercy from their Lord, and they are the rightly guided.
Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim said, "Abu Basir said, 'If you heard nothing in your lifetime except this report, it would be enough for you. So guard it except from those worthy of it.'"

quotes.caption: - The Prophet, Kamal al-Din, p. 289, carried also by Uyun al-Akhbar, Ithbat al-Hudat, and Bihar

paragraphs.text: 4 - حدثنا علي بن أحمد ﵁ قال : حدثنا محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي عن موسى بن عمران ، عن عمه الحسين بن يزيد ، عن الحسن بن علي بن أبي حمزة ، عن أبيه ، عن يحيى بن أبي القاسم ، عن الصادق جعفر بن محمد ، عن أبيه ، عن جده ﵈ قال : قال رسول الله ﵌ : الأئمة بعدي اثنا عشر أولهم علي بن أبي طالب وآخرهم القائم ، هم خلفائي وأوصيائي وأوليائي ، وحجج الله على أمتي بعدي ، المقر بهم مؤمن ، والمنكر لهم كافر (2) .

Ali ibn Ahmad narrated to us. He said that Muhammad ibn Abi Abd Allah al-Kufi narrated to us from Musa ibn Imran, from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from his father, from Yahya ibn Abi al-Qasim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, who said

The Messenger of God said, "The Imams after me are twelve. The first of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib, and the last of them is al-Qa'im. They are my successors, my trustees, my friends, and God's proofs against my community after me. Whoever acknowledges them is a believer, and whoever denies them is an unbeliever."

quotes.caption: - Al-Saduq, Kamal al-Din, pp. 97-98, Sunni-chained reports and his verdict

paragraphs.text: عهد إلينا نبينا ﵌ أنه يكون من بعده اثنا عشر خليفة بعدد نقباء بني إسرائيل . وقد أخرجت بعض طرق هذا الحديث في هذا الكتاب وبعضها في كتاب النص على الأئمة الاثني عشر ﵈ . بالإمامة . ونقل مخالفونا من أصحاب الحديث نقلا ظاهرا مستفيضا من حديث جابر بن سمرة ما حدثنا به أحمد بن محمد بن إسحاق الدينوري ، وكان من أصحاب الحديث قال : حدثني أبو بكر بن أبي داود (1) ، عن إسحاق بن إبراهيم ابن شاذان ، عن الوليد بن هشام ، عن محمد بن ذكوان (2) قال : حدثني أبي ، عن أبيه ، عن ابن سيرين ، عن جابر بن سمرة السوائي قال : كنا عند النبي ﵌ فقال : يلي هذه الأمة اثنا عشر ، قال : فصرخ الناس فلم أسمع ما قال : فقلت لأبي - وكان أقرب إلى رسول الله ﵌ مني : ما قال : رسول الله ﵌ ؟ فقال : قال : كلهم من قريش وكلهم لا يرى مثله . وقد أخرجت طرق هذا الحديث أيضا ، وبعضهم روى " اثنا عشر أميرا " ، وبعضهم روى " اثنا عشر خليفة " فدل ذلك على أن الاخبار التي في يد الامامية ، عن النبي ﵌ والأئمة ﵈ بذكر الأئمة الاثني عشر أخبار صحيحة (3) .
[Ibn Mas’ud continued,] “Our Prophet entrusted us that after him there would be twelve caliphs, equal in number to the nuqaba of the Children of Israel.”
[Al-Saduq writes:] I have presented some of the chains of this report in this book and some in the book on the designation of the twelve Imams to the Imamate.

Our opponents among the traditionists have transmitted widely and openly the report of Jabir ibn Samurah. Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Dinawari, who was among the traditionists, narrated to us that Abu Bakr ibn Abi Dawud narrated to him from Ishaq ibn Ibrahim ibn Shadhan, from al-Walid ibn Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Dhakwan, who said that his father narrated to him from his father, from Ibn Sirin, from Jabir ibn Samurah al-Suwa'i, who said
We were with the Prophet when he said, "Twelve will rule this community."
The people cried out, and I did not hear what he said. I said to my father, who was closer to the Messenger of God than I was, "What did the Messenger of God say?"
He said, "He said that all of them are from Quraysh, and none of them will be seen to have his like."

I have also presented the chains of this report. Some of them narrated "twelve commanders," and some narrated "twelve caliphs." This indicates that the reports held by the Imamiyya from the Prophet and the Imams concerning the mention of the twelve Imams are sound reports.

quotes.caption: - Imam al-Baqir, al-Kafi, vol. 1, p. 580

paragraphs.text: 10 - علي بن إبراهيم ، عن محمد بن عيسى بن عبيد ، عن محمد بن الفضيل ، عن أبي حمزة ، عن أبي جعفر ﵇ قال : إن الله أرسل محمدا ﵌ إلى الجن والإنس وجعل من بعده اثني عشر وصيا ، منهم من سبق ومنهم من بقي وكل وصي جرت به سنة والأوصياء الذين من بعد محمد ﵌ على سنة أوصياء عيسى وكانوا اثني عشر وكان أمير المؤمنين ﵇ على سنة المسيح .

Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Jafar, who said, "Allah sent Muhammad to the jinn and humankind, and after him He appointed twelve trustees. Some of them have passed and some remain. Each trustee has had a pattern run through him. The trustees after Muhammad follow the pattern of the trustees of Jesus. They were twelve, and the Commander of the Faithful followed the pattern of the Messiah."

quotes.caption: - Al-Khidr's testimony, al-Kafi, vol. 1, pp. 573–574

paragraphs.text: فالتفت أمير المؤمنين ﵇ إلى الحسن فقال : يا أبا محمد أجبه ، قال : فأجابه الحسن ﵇ فقال الرجل أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله ولم أزل أشهد بها وأشهد أن محمدا رسول الله ولم أزل أشهد بذلك وأشهد أنك وصي رسول الله ﵌ والقائم بحجته - وأشار إلى أمير المؤمنين - ولم أزل أشهد بها وأشهد أنك وصيه والقائم بحجته - وأشار إلى الحسن ﵇ - وأشهد أن الحسين بن علي وصي أخيه والقائم بحجته بعده وأشهد على علي بن الحسين أنه القائم بأمر الحسين بعده وأشهد على محمد بن علي أنه القائم بأمر علي بن الحسين وأشهد على جعفر بن محمد بأنه القائم بأمر محمد وأشهد على موسى أنه القائم بأمر جعفر بن محمد وأشهد على علي بن موسى أنه القائم بأمر موسى بن جعفر وأشهد على محمد بن علي أنه القائم بأمر علي ابن موسى وأشهد على علي بن محمد بأنه القائم بأمر محمد بن علي وأشهد على الحسن بن علي بأنه القائم بأمر علي بن محمد وأشهد على رجل من ولد الحسن لا يكنى ولا يسمى حتى يظهر أمره فيملاها عدلا كما ملئت جورا والسلام عليك يا أمير المؤمنين ورحمة الله وبركاته ، ثم قام فمضى ، فقال أمير المؤمنين : يا أبا محمد اتبعه فانظر أين يقصد فخرج الحسن بن علي ﵉ فقال : ما كان إلا أن وضع رجله خارجا من المسجد فما دريت أين أخذ من أرض الله ، فرجعت إلى أمير المؤمنين ﵇ فأعلمته ، فقال : يا أبا محمد أتعرفه ؟ قلت : الله ورسوله وأمير المؤمنين أعلم ، قال : هو الخضر ﵇ .
The Commander of the Faithful turned to al-Hasan and said, "O Abu Muhammad, answer him."

Al-Hasan answered him. The man said, "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I have never ceased to bear witness to it. I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and I have never ceased to bear witness to that. I bear witness that you are the trustee of the Messenger of Allah and the one who upholds his proof," and he pointed to the Commander of the Faithful. "I have never ceased to bear witness to it. I bear witness that you are his trustee and the one who upholds his proof," and he pointed to al-Hasan. "I bear witness that al-Husayn ibn Ali is the trustee of his brother and the one who upholds his proof after him. I bear witness concerning Ali ibn al-Husayn that he is the one who upholds the affair of al-Husayn after him.

I bear witness concerning Muhammad ibn Ali that he is the one who upholds the affair of Ali ibn al-Husayn. I bear witness concerning Jafar ibn Muhammad that he is the one who upholds the affair of Muhammad. I bear witness concerning Musa that he is the one who upholds the affair of Jafar ibn Muhammad.

I bear witness concerning Ali ibn Musa that he is the one who upholds the affair of Musa ibn Jafar. I bear witness concerning Muhammad ibn Ali that he is the one who upholds the affair of Ali ibn Musa. I bear witness concerning Ali ibn Muhammad that he is the one who upholds the affair of Muhammad ibn Ali. I bear witness concerning al-Hasan ibn Ali that he is the one who upholds the affair of Ali ibn Muhammad.

I bear witness concerning a man from the descendants of al-Hasan, who is neither given a kunyah nor named until his affair appears, and he will fill it with justice as it has been filled with tyranny. Peace be upon you, Commander of the Faithful, and Allah's mercy and blessings."
Then he rose and left. The Commander of the Faithful said, "O Abu Muhammad, follow him and see where he is going."
Al-Hasan ibn Ali went out and said, "As soon as he put his foot outside the mosque, I did not know where in Allah's earth he had gone."
I returned to the Commander of the Faithful and informed him. He said, "O Abu Muhammad, do you know him?"
I said, "Allah, His Messenger, and the Commander of the Faithful know best."
He said, "He is al-Khidr."

quotes.caption: - The Prophet, Sahih Muslim, Kitab al-Imara, Jabir ibn Samura's reports

paragraphs.text: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد حدثنا جرير عن حصين عن جابر بن سمرة قال سمعت النبي ﵌ يقول ح وحدثنا رفاعة بن الهيثم الواسطي (واللفظ له) حدثنا خالد (يعنى ابن عبد الله الطحان) عن حصين عن جابر بن سمرة قال دخلت مع أبي على النبي ﵌ فسمعته يقول إن هذا الامر لا ينقضي حتى يمضى فيهم اثنا عشر خليفة قال ثم تكلم بكلام خفى على قال فقلت لأبي ما قال قال كلهم من قريش حدثنا ابن أبي عمر حدثنا سفيان عن عبد الملك بن عمير عن جابر بن سمرة قال سمعت النبي ﵌ يقول لا يزال امر الناس ماضيا ما وليهم اثنا عشر رجلا ثم تكلم النبي ﷺ بكلمة خفيت على فسألت أبى ماذا قال رسول الله ﷺ فقال كلهم من قريش
Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us from Husayn, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said, "I heard the Prophet say."

It was also narrated to us by Rifa'ah ibn al-Haytham al-Wasiti, and this is his wording. Khalid, meaning Ibn Abd Allah al-Tahhan, narrated to us from Husayn, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said, "I entered with my father upon the Prophet, and I heard him say, 'This matter will not end until twelve caliphs have passed among them.' He then spoke words that were indistinct to me. I said to my father, 'What did he say?' He said, 'All of them are from Quraysh.'"

Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us from Abd al-Malik ibn Umayr, from Jabir ibn Samurah, who said, "I heard the Prophet say, 'The affairs of the people will continue as long as twelve men rule them.' Then the Prophet spoke a word that was indistinct to me, so I asked my father, 'What did the Messenger of God say?' He said, 'All of them are from Quraysh.'"

quotes.caption: - Ibn Mas'ud's report, Ahadith al-Mahdi min Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal, p. 43, citing Musnad Ahmad, vol. 1, p. 398

paragraphs.text: (33) حدثنا عبد اللّه ، حدثني أبي ، ثنا حسن بن موسى ، ثنا حماد بن زيد عن المجالد ، عن الشعبي ، عن مسروق ، قال : كنا جلوسا عند عبد اللّه بن مسعود ، - وهو يقرئنا القرآن - ، فقال له رجل : يا أبا عبد الرحمن هل سألتم رسول اللّه ﵆ كم تملك هذه الأمة من خليفة ؟ فقال عبد اللّه بن مسعود : ما سألني عنها أحد منذ قدمت العراق قبلك ، ثم قال : نعم ، ولقد سألنا رسول اللّه ﵆ فقال : اثنا عشر ، كعدّة نقباء (1) بني إسرائيل . 1 / 398
(33) Abd Allah told us. My father told me. Hasan ibn Musa told us. Hammad ibn Zayd told us, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, who said
We were sitting with Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud while he was teaching us the Quran. A man said to him, "Abu Abd al-Rahman, did you ask the Messenger of God how many caliphs will rule this community?"

Abd Allah ibn Mas'ud said, "No one has asked me about it before you since I came to Iraq." Then he said, "Yes, we did ask the Messenger of God, and he said, 'Twelve, equal to the number of the nuqaba of the Children of Israel.'"
Musnad, volume 1, page 398

quotes.caption: - The Prophet, Sunan Abi Dawud, vol. 4, p. 175, report 4282

paragraphs.text: (4282) - حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَهُمْ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ - يَعْنِي : ابْنَ عَيَّاشٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، أَخْبَرَنَا زَائِدَةُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى ، عَنْ فِطْرٍ - الْمَعْنَى - وَاحِدٌ ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ زِرٍّ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، عَنْ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ : « لَوْ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا يَوْمٌ » - قَالَ زَائِدَةُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ : « لَطَوَّلَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ » - ثُمَّ اتَّفَقُوا : « حَتَّى يَبْعَثَ فِيهِ رَجُلًا مِنِّي أَوْ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي يُوَاطِئُ اسْمُهُ اسْمِي وَاسْمُ أَبِيهِ اسْمُ أَبِي زَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ فِطْرٍ : « يَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ قِسْطًا وَعَدْلًا كَمَا مُلِئَتْ ظُلْمًا وَجَوْرًا » - وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ : « لَا تَذْهَبُ أَوْ لَا تَنْقَضِي الدُّنْيَا حَتَّى يَمْلِكَ الْعَرَبَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي يُوَاطِئُ اسْمُهُ اسْمِي » . قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد : لَفْظُ عُمَرَ وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ بِمَعْنَى سُفْيَانَ .

(4282) Musaddad narrated to us that Umar ibn Ubayd narrated to them. Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated to us. Abu Bakr, meaning Ibn Ayyash, narrated to us. Musaddad narrated to us. Yahya narrated to us, from Sufyan. Ahmad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to us. Za'idah informed us. Ahmad ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Musa narrated to me, from Fitr. The meaning is one.

All of them narrated from Asim, from Zirr, from Abd Allah, from the Prophet, who said, "Even if only one day remained of this world," Za'idah said in his report, "Allah would lengthen that day," then they agreed, "until He sends in it a man from me or from my Household, whose name corresponds to my name and whose father's name corresponds to my father's name."
Fitr added in his report, "He will fill the earth with equity and justice as it has been filled with oppression and tyranny."
Sufyan said in his report, "The world will not pass away, or will not come to an end, until a man from my Household whose name corresponds to my name rules the Arabs."
Abu Dawud said, "The wording of Umar and Abu Bakr has the same meaning as that of Sufyan."

quotes.caption: - Al-Nawawi, Sharh Sahih Muslim, vol. 12, pp. 200-201

paragraphs.text: قوله (﵌) (أن هذا الأمر لا ينقضي حتى يمضي فيهم اثنا عشر خليفة كلهم من قريش) وفي رواية لا يزال أمر الناس ماضيا ما وليهم اثنا عشر رجلا كلهم من قريش [وفي رواية لا يزال الإسلام عزيزا إلى اثنى عشر خليفة كلهم من قريش قال القاضي قد توجه هنا سؤالان أحدهما أنه قد جاء في الحديث الآخر الخلافة بعدي ثلاثون سنة ثم تكون ملكا وهذا مخالف لحديث اثنى عشر خليفة فإنه لم يكن في ثلاثين سنة إلا الخلفاء الراشدون الأربعة والأشهر التي بويع فيها الحسن بن علي قال والجواب عن هذا أن المراد في حديث الخلافة ثلاثون سنة خلافة النبوة وقد جاء مفسرا في بعض الروايات خلافة النبوة بعدي ثلاثون سنة ثم تكون ملكا ولم يشترط هذا في الاثني عشر السؤال الثاني أنه قد ولى أكثر من هذا العدد قال وهذا اعتراض باطل لأنه (﵌) لم يقل لا يلي إلا اثنى عشر خليفة وإنما قال يلي وقد ولي هذا العدد ولا يضر كونه وجد بعدهم غيرهم

His statement, "This matter will not end until twelve caliphs have passed among them, all of them from Quraysh." In one version, "The affairs of the people will continue as long as twelve men rule them, all of them from Quraysh." In another version, "Islam will remain mighty until twelve caliphs, all of them from Quraysh."

Al-Qadi said that two questions arise here. The first is that another report states, "The caliphate after me will last thirty years, then there will be kingship." This conflicts with the report of twelve caliphs, for within thirty years there were only the four Rightly Guided Caliphs and the months during which Hasan ibn Ali received allegiance.

He said that the answer is that the caliphate meant in the report of thirty years is the caliphate of prophethood. This is explained in some versions, "The caliphate of prophethood after me will last thirty years, then there will be kingship." This was not stipulated regarding the twelve.

The second question is that more than this number have ruled. He said that this objection is invalid, because he did not say that only twelve caliphs would rule. Rather, he said that they would rule. This number has ruled, and it does not matter that others were found after them.

quotes.caption: - Ibn Abbas's rebuke, Kanz al-Ummal, vol. 14, entry 39657

paragraphs.text: 39657 عن سعيد بن جبير قال : سمعنا ابن عباس ونحن نقول : اثنا عشر أميرا ثم لا أمير ، واثنا عشر أميرا ثم هي الساعة ، فقال : ما أحمقكم ! إن منا أهل البيت بعد ذلك : المنصور والسفاح والمهدي يدفعها إلى عيسى ابن مريم (كر) .

Sa'id ibn Jubayr said, "Ibn Abbas heard us saying, 'Twelve commanders, then no commander. Twelve commanders, then the Hour.' He said, 'How foolish you are. After that, among us, the people of the House, are al-Mansur, al-Saffah, and al-Mahdi. He will hand it over to Jesus son of Mary.'"

quotes.caption: - Isaiah 11:1-9, Westminster Leningrad Codex, Arabic corpus transcription, King James Version

"And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD; And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked. (4285) - حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ تَمَّامِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ الْقَطَّانُ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ، قَالَ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ : « الْمَهْدِيُّ مِنِّي أَجْلَى الْجَبْهَةِ ، أَقْنَى الْأَنْفِ ، يَمْلَأُ الْأَرْضَ قِسْطًا وَعَدْلًا كَمَا مُلِئَتْ جَوْرًا وَظُلْمًا ، يَمْلِكُ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ » .
She said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah say, 'The Mahdi is from my descendants, from the children of Fatimah.'"
Abd Allah ibn Jafar said, "I heard Abu al-Malih praise Ali ibn Nufayl and mention his righteousness."

(4285) Sahl ibn Tammam ibn Bazi narrated to us. Imran al-Qattan narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Said al-Khudri, who said, "The Messenger of Allah said, 'The Mahdi is from me. He has a broad forehead and an aquiline nose. He will fill the earth with equity and justice as it has been filled with tyranny and oppression. He will rule for seven years.'"

paragraphs.text: الحسن ، عن العلاء بن بشير (1) ، عن أبي الصديق الناجي ، عن أبي سعيد الخدري ، عن النبيّ ﵌ أنّه قال : أبشروا بالمهدي ، رجل من عترتي ، يخرج في اختلاف من الناس وزلازل ، فيملأ الأرض قسطا وعدلا ، كما ملئت جورا وظلما ، ويرضى عنه ساكن السماء ، وساكن الأرض ، ويقسم المال صحاحا (2) . قالوا : وما صحاحا ؟ قالوا : بالسويّة ، ويملأ اللّه قلوب امّة محمّد ﵌ غناء ، ويسعهم عدله ، حتّى أنّه ليأمر مناديه فينادي : من له إلى مال حاجة ؟ فما يأتيه أحد ، إلّا رجل واحد ، يأتيه فيسأله ، فيقول له : انطلق إلى السادن ، حتّى يعطيك . قال : فيأتيه فيقول له : أنا رسول المهديّ ، لتعطيني مالا ، فيقول له : احث (3) ، فيحثي فلا يستطيع أن يحمله ، فيلقي حتّى يكون قدر ما يستطيع حمله ، فيخرج به ، فيندم . فيقول : إذا ، كنت أجشع امّة محمّد نفسا ، دعتني إلى هذا المال ، وقد تركه غيري ، قال : فيرجع ، فيردّه عليه ، فيقول له : هذا المال لا نقبل منه شيئا ، اعطيناكه . قال : فيلبث بذلك سبعا ، [ أو ] ثمانيا ، [ أو ] تسع سنين (4) ، كذلك لا خير في الحياة بعده (5) .

Al-Hasan, from al-Ala ibn Bashir (1), from Abu al-Siddiq al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet, who said, "Receive glad tidings of the Mahdi, a man from my progeny. He will emerge amid disagreement among people and earthquakes. He will fill the earth with equity and justice as it has been filled with injustice and oppression. The inhabitant of heaven and the inhabitant of earth will be pleased with him, and he will distribute wealth in full portions (2)."

They said, "What does 'in full portions' mean?" He said, "Equally." God will fill the hearts of Muhammad's community with sufficiency, and his justice will encompass them, so much so that he will order his caller to proclaim, "Who has need of wealth?" No one will come to him except one man. He will come and ask him, and he will say to him, "Go to the keeper, so that he may give you."

He said, "He will go to him and say, 'I am the Mahdi's messenger, so give me wealth.' He will say to him, 'Take a handful' (3). He will take a handful, but will not be able to carry it. So he will put back enough that he can carry, then leave with it and regret it. He will say, 'Then I am the most covetous soul in Muhammad's community. This wealth called me, while others left it.' He will return and give it back to him, but he will say, 'We do not accept anything back from this wealth. We gave it to you.'"
He will remain thus for seven, or eight, or nine years (4). There is no good in life after him (5).

quotes.caption: - Abu Hurayra's report, Ahadith al-Mahdi min Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal, p. 64, report 97, citing Musnad Ahmad, vol. 2, p. 336

paragraphs.text: (97) حدثنا عبد اللّه ، حدثني أبي ، ثنا عثمان بن عمر ، ثنا ابن أبي ذئب ، عن الزهري ، عن نافع - مولى أبي قتادة - ، عن أبي هريرة : ان النبي ﵆ قال : كيف بكم إذا نزل فيكم عيسى بن مريم وامامكم منكم . 2 / 336

(97) Abdullah narrated to us. My father narrated to me. Uthman ibn Umar narrated to us. Ibn Abi Dhi'b narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Nafi', the freedman of Abu Qatada, from Abu Hurayra, that the Prophet said, "How will you be when Jesus son of Mary descends among you and your imam is from among you?"
Volume 2, page 336.

quotes.caption: - Ibn Abbas's report, Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 51, p. 73, from Kamal al-Din

paragraphs.text: 12 - إكمال الدين : ابن مسرور ، عن ابن عامر ، عن المعلى ، عن جعفر بن سليمان ، عن عبد الله بن الحكم ، عن أبيه ، عن سعيد بن جبير ، عن ابن عباس قال : قال رسول الله ﵌ : إن خلفائي وأوصيائي وحجج الله على الخلق بعدي اثنا عشر أولهم أخي وآخرهم ولدي وقيل : يا رسول الله ﵌ ومن أخوك ؟ قال : علي بن أبي طالب قيل فمن ولدك ؟ قال : المهدي يملاها قسطا وعدلا كما ملئت جورا وظلما والذي بعثني بالحق نبيا لو لم يبق من الدنيا إلا يوم واحد لأطال الله ذلك اليوم حتى يخرج فيه ولدي المهدي فينزل روح الله عيسى بن مريم ﵇ فيصلي خلفه وتشرق الأرض بنور ربها ويبلغ سلطانه المشرق والمغرب .

Kamal al-Din. Ibn Masrur, from Ibn Amir, from al-Mualla, from Jafar ibn Sulayman, from Abd Allah ibn al-Hakam, from his father, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said, "The Messenger of Allah said, 'My successors, my trustees, and Allah's proofs over creation after me are twelve. The first of them is my brother and the last of them is my son.'"

It was said, "Messenger of Allah, who is your brother?" He said, "Ali ibn Abi Talib." It was said, "Then who is your son?" He said, "The Mahdi. He will fill it with equity and justice as it has been filled with tyranny and oppression. By Him who sent me with the truth as a prophet, if only one day remained of the world, Allah would lengthen that day until my son, the Mahdi, emerges in it. Then Jesus son of Mary, the Spirit of Allah, will descend and pray behind him. The earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and his authority will reach the east and the west."

quotes.caption: - Imam al-Rida, Uyun Akhbar al-Rida, vol. 2, p. 218

paragraphs.text: قال ﵇ : إذا خرج المهدي من ولدي نزل عيسى بن مريم ﵇ فصلى خلفه
He said, “When the Mahdi from among my descendants emerges, Jesus son of Mary will descend and pray behind him.”

paragraphs.text: ومنكم القائم يصلي عيسى بن مريم خلفه إذا أهبطه الله إلى الأرض من ذرية علي وفاطمة من ولد الحسين (﵈) .
From among you is the Qa’im, behind whom Jesus son of Mary will pray when God sends him down to the earth. He is from the descendants of Ali and Fatimah, from the line of al-Husayn.

paragraphs.text: 118 - وقال : حدثنا المظفر بن جعفر العلوي عن جعفر بن محمّد بن مسعود عن أبيه عن جبرئيل بن أحمد عن موسى بن جعفر البغدادي عن الحسن بن محمّد الصيرفي عن حنان بن سدير عن أبيه عن أبي سعيد عقيصا عن الحسن بن علي ﵇ في حديث قال : أما علمتم أنه ما منا أحد إلا وتقع في عنقه بيعة لطاغية زمانه إلا القائم الذي يصلّي عيسى بن مريم خلفه ، وإن اللّه ﷿ يخفي ولادته ويغيب شخصه لئلا يكون لأحد في عنقه بيعة إذا خرج ذلك التاسع من ولد أخي الحسين ابن سيدة النساء يطيل اللّه عمره في غيبته ثم يظهره بقدرته في صورة شاب ابن دون أربعين سنة ليعلم أن اللّه على كل شيء قدير (4) .

He said, "Al-Muzaffar ibn Jafar al-Alawi narrated to us, from Jafar ibn Muhammad ibn Masud, from his father, from Jibril ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Jafar al-Baghdadi, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi, from Hannan ibn Sudayr, from his father, from Abu Said Uqaysa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, in a report in which he said,
'Do you not know that there is none of us except that allegiance to the tyrant of his time falls upon his neck, except the Qa'im, behind whom Jesus son of Mary will pray?

Allah conceals his birth and hides his person so that no one's allegiance may be upon his neck when he emerges. That ninth one from the descendants of my brother al-Husayn, son of the Lady of Women, Allah will prolong his life during his occultation, then He will manifest him by His power in the form of a young man under forty years old, so that it may be known that Allah has power over all things.'"
